- **[DS-T1-012](DS-T1-012-the-fuel-queue/README.md): The Fuel Queue: Simulating a Filling Station During Scarcity.** Derive the M/M/c results, build and validate a queue simulator, estimate demand from a filling-station log with balking, and decide how many pumps to staff when the exponential textbook model is quietly optimistic.
- **[DS-T1-013](DS-T1-013-how-sure-are-we/README.md): How Sure Are We? Bootstrap and Analytical Intervals Under a Coverage Experiment.** Implement t, Wald, Wilson, exact and bootstrap (percentile, basic, BCa) intervals from scratch, test their 95% promise with a Monte Carlo coverage experiment, and report honest intervals for a skewed, rare-event survey of POS and mobile-money agents.
- **[DS-T1-014](DS-T1-014-collision-course/README.md): Collision Course: How Long Must a Booking Reference Be?.** Derive and stably compute birthday-problem collision probabilities, verify them by simulation, use two days of BRT booking references to show the generator's real code space is about 50 times smaller than designed, and recommend a reference length and design.
